PB-T01.proof: The transition indices j=0,...,n-1 are partitioned uniquely by their ordered packet pair (x_j,x_{j+1}); summing multiplicities counts each actual transition exactly once.

PB-T02.proof: Under shared-endpoint-once concatenation, the transition list of gamma*eta is exactly the ordered transition list of gamma followed by that of eta; identifying the common packet creates no extra transition.

PB-T03.proof: The index bijection j -> n-1-j sends each transition x_j->x_{j+1} to the reversed transition x_{j+1}->x_j exactly once.

PB-T04.proof: The row sum is DEPART_gamma(x), the column sum is ARRIVE_gamma(x), so the frozen Stage-A endpoint incidence identity applies exactly.
